why: The hall's respawn wait, stretched one second past two minutes. A fallen player who waits that long has stopped being part of the fight the party is having and is only watching it, which is past the range a wait may take (1 to 120 seconds). It declares no unit: `respawn_wait`, its `seconds` and its `alone` are each written by the gallery proper. What must not compile is a wait outside the range; the refusal names the field and the range. The other half of the same rule, a wait with no checkpoint to come back to, is refused by the same code and is pinned in `crates/delvec/tests/respawn_wait.rs`, because the gallery cannot lose its bonfires without losing half of what it binds.
